title: Cimmino 2013 · Von Frey tactile detection
citation: Cimmino et al. (2013). Plasticity of body representations after surgical arm elongation in an achondroplasic patient. Restorative Neurology and Neuroscience, 31(3), 287–298.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.context: Companion outcome in the surgical arm-elongation case study.
published_method.stimulus: Apply the North Coast Medical monofilament perpendicular to the arm until it bends. The labelled range is 0.008–300 g.
published_method.response: Record verbal detection. The study’s table uses a score whose physical unit cannot be resolved from the Methods.

Exact arm site, force-level steps, contact durations and tabulated score units are unresolved.
